title: Top word with a tie rule
prompt: Implement `static string TopWord(List<string> words)` — the most frequent word; on a tie, the **alphabetically first**. Every list has at least one word.

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.TopWord(new List<string> { "milo", "milo", "ajax", "ajax" }), "ajax", "tie broken alphabetically");
Cj.Eq(Solution.TopWord(new List<string> { "c", "c", "a" }), "c", "clear winner");
tests.hint: The tie case is the contract — count first, name second.

tests.name: edges
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.TopWord(new List<string> { "b", "a" }), "a", "all tied");
Cj.Eq(Solution.TopWord(new List<string> { "zulu", "zulu", "alpha", "bravo", "bravo", "alpha" }), "alpha", "three-way tie");
tests.hint: Insertion order must not leak into the result.
